raised_by: owner, mid-run integrity check: the report summary's action counts summed to 76 while PLAN-V2.1 has 77 acceptance criteria
verdict: REPORTING_SUMMARY_OMISSION — the frozen audit artifact is complete and internally consistent; the prose summary was wrong
what_the_prose_got_wrong: The report quoted 75 KEEP_CHANGE + 1 MOVE_CHANGE_OWNER = 76. Those are the counts of the audit run over PLAN-V2 (76 criteria), taken before AC-STORY-01-01-7 was added. The frozen V2.1 artifact records 76 KEEP_CHANGE + 1 MOVE_CHANGE_OWNER = 77. The criterion the prose dropped is AC-STORY-01-01-7, the new introduction owner, whose action is KEEP_CHANGE.

is_the_missing_action_a_preserve_downstr.why: AC-STORY-04-01-2 carries exactly one action, MOVE_CHANGE_OWNER, and its downstream disposition is a separate field on the same row (`downstream_disposition`: PRESERVE_DOWNSTREAM), so that one criterion is never counted twice. PRESERVE_DOWNSTREAM therefore reads 0 in the action counter by construction, and the row also records to_mode PRESERVE_REQUIRED, to_requirement FR-12, also_add_change_to STORY-01-01, and already_applied_in_this_plan true.

corrected_summary: 77 criteria, one ownership action each: 76 KEEP_CHANGE and 1 MOVE_CHANGE_OWNER (AC-STORY-04-01-2, whose downstream disposition is PRESERVE_DOWNSTREAM and whose introduction owner becomes STORY-01-01 through the new AC-STORY-01-01-7). 0 REMOVE_DUPLICATE.
action_taken: None on the plan, the proof modes, the kernel, the profile, the prompts or the running qualification. This record is additive; the audit artifact is left byte-identical.
